captions.detailed: A tower-mounted two-branch rotary stand featuring a heavy, circular black base with a central vertical cylindrical tower. Two grey, single-member radial arms are mounted on separate collars along the height of the tower. Each grey arm is designed as a rigid member that rotates independently around the tower's central vertical axis via a continuous revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a tower-mounted two-branch rotary stand with a heavy circular black base, a vertical central tower, and two independently rotating grey radial arms mounted at different heights on the tower using continuous revolute joints.
captions.factory: Construct a base part using a large cylinder as the base plate, a smaller concentric cylinder as the hub, and an elongated central vertical cylinder as the tower spindle. Create two identical arm parts, each built by extruding a 2D sketch consisting of a ring collar and a tapered radial extension arm. Assemble the model by defining the base as the root and attaching each of the two arm parts to the tower spindle with separate revolute joint articulations at different heights.
